notes.title: Patch #21, Improvements & Fixes + Upcoming Content
notes.content: [p]Hi Chefs! We hope you have been enjoying the new festivals! It’s really been exciting for us to see players trying out the new content. Big thanks to everyone posting suggestions and reports! A couple quick patches were made the previous week to fix some specific issues that players brought up. Here is one last patch to address some things we’ve noticed since the update.[/p][p][/p][p][u][b]Improvements[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p]We’ve had many reports of the magnifying glass getting in the way of using tools. Since the magnifying glass is less commonly used, selected tools will now always override the magnifying glass. If your current selected item is a usable tool, you must swap to a different slot in order to use the magnifying glass. (For indoor scenes, you do not need to swap slots since tools cannot be used indoors). This way, the magnifying glass will never get in the way of using tools.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Farmers Wager tutorial during the Spring Harvest can now be started from the festival booth, as well as with speaking with Mae-Lou.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Random NPC chat bubbles will no longer pop up during cutscenes.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]A dialogue will now pop up when trying to claim festival prize with a full inventory.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][u][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p]Fixed Amethyst Lance blueprint producing incorrect product item.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed some festival furniture items having different visuals after being placed.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed a UI error when trying to exchange festival rewards with a full inventory.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed “Last Call” button reappearing after opening and closing main menu.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed restaurant UI disappearing after using “Last Call” with a controller.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][u][b]Additions[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p]Dozens of new furniture items have been added to both the regular furniture shop, and festival exchanges. (Bathtubs, decorative vases, and floor tiles).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/dd09f5833180231aedcc22949d532da4a540f32a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Our next major update will be focused on the restaurant gameplay and ingredient gathering. We will also implement quality of life suggestions related to the restaurant (like a pocket menu, and more sorting tools). More info soon![/p]

notes.title: Food and Festivals Major Update!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/7704907d2aa2fc7fbaa2110c39bdb0c2f1a570a2.png"][/img][/p][p]Hi Chefs, our largest update Food & Festivals (Version 0.7) is here! This festival introduces 5 seasonal festivals, as well as overhauls of several cooking minigames. To celebrate this update, Chef RPG will be 20% off until September 6![/p][p][/p][p]MINOR SPOILERS BELOW [/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/0ceff4dc380ea421ef27f7cab35104fd0615bde1.png"][/img][/p][p]It's time to celebrate the spirit of the season! Festivals will take place on set dates throughout the year. Festivals are not instanced, meaning you can still engage in most open-world activities while a festival is active. You can talk to festival goers and purchase unique items without participating in the main events.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/b100a6d6d4320b462e8c5b1c888edceeb88f35cf.png"][/img][/p][p]Each festival contains a unique activity and rewards, but the structure of each festival follows a similar format. The day before a festival begins, you will be immediately taken to the festival site to view a cutscene, where you can see the characters beginning to set up. Festivals will be marked on the map, visible in the calendar, and you will receive a festival flier in the mail the day before, so they will be hard to miss![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/6284ed453cde7d5cc6df31b1eda4bb9a144f54fd.png"][/img][/p][p]On the day of a festival, head over to the event site to join the festivities. Each festival contains a main event, where you must sign up at the main booth to participate. Some events are done solo, while other events require choosing a teammate. Most events are competitive, meaning the better your placement in the event, the better the reward.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/0dab3c72e48822ec7ec25ea56a819eb59976802b.png"][/img][/p][p]Completing various activities during festivals will reward you with Festival Tokens, which you can exchange for unique seasonal prizes. Festival Tokens carry over, meaning you can save them up to spend on a different festival, instead of one that you earned them in.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/a031406f09b470c9cb2d4edbf29274dc0e30e4dc.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/92900ec18abdd72de56f3e6b2f1bbec9eff3e891.png"][/img][/p][p]Anna-May & Mae-Lou are hosting a farmers market to celebrate their recent harvest. Head over to Takashi Farms on the 14th day of Spring to join the party! This is an introductory festival, and is non-competitive.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/ca9f153cd962a7f8ed4f44a9ec1d2aa80675019a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/d3448c5dc87e81bfa5262dec69ceb1f87d4aaaf4.png"][/img][/p][p]It’s the hottest day of the year! Celebrate with the townsfolk on the eastern beach, on the 22nd day of Summer. End the night with a lantern lighting competition![/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/157c307df35698c27664132f6c6f217259230926.png"][/img][/p][p]A relatively new tradition in White Ash Harbor, embrace the spirit of Autumn by smashing pumpkins! Compete against other characters to see who can smash the most Pumpkins inside the time limit. Collect dozens of pumpkin-themed items and furniture. The Pumpkin hunt takes place in the Ashy Swamps on the 17th day of Autumn. A short side quest (repeatable every year) is available in the days before this event, if you have unlocked the Greenhouse.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/9f66e44fe68e8693684e8aec35a8654ce80476af.png"][/img][/p][p]An age-old tradition in White Ash Harbor. Work together with the townsfolk to guide the spirits towards sources of food. Head to the hills north of the town square on the 26th day of Autumn to join this spooky event. A short side quest is available only during this event. (Note* The Tea of Life quest in Act 2 must have been started for this festival to appear).[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/222a324126ec88b0cadcd3011b33147d3463612f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/03488c254f505e85a8845a82a8c75aedf1109979.png"][/img][/p][p]This is the White Ash Harbor’s biggest event! Everyone in town will be participating, and tourists travel far and wide to see it. Join the townsfolk and work together to bake a giant gingerbread house! This festival takes place over 3 days, beginning on the 25th day of Winter, and ending on the 27th.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/09d85b1e457b25bf61ac788e845c70c4c5108716.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/b622e286378512f9157c30660830983faf038bef.png"][/img][/p][p]Several cooking minigames have been overhauled. We have begun introducing physics into certain cooking minigames, which we may be able to expand upon. In the future, this unlocks the potential for customizing dishes. Also, minigame lengths have been slightly reduced, so you can cook dishes faster during a service.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][u][b]BARISTA MACHINE[/b][/u][/p][p]The Barista Machine minigame has been completely redesigned. It is now a physics based game without a fixed time (you decide to play at your own pace).[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/c325ac4df6e9e1beb11048a94e884827e21491b7.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b][u]MIXING STATION[/u][/b][/p][p]The Blender has been replaced with the Mixing Station, and the minigame has been completely redesigned. Recipes that require Blenders has switched to Mixing Stations, so you do not need to change anything in your menu or restaurant![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/5a2ced51264878e88d299785224aeae8901f98e6.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b][u]STOVE[/u][/b][/p][p]The Stove minigame has new visuals, and a extra physics-based step.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/8e9393343b98741eebe8228bbbaa2748b7fdada7.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b][u]OVEN[/u][/b][/p][p]The oven has overhauled visuals. There is now an extra step in the cooking process.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/7a2dae72ceb753dc7e26d2e537f3cc7ef61e2b37.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b][u]COOKING COUNTER[/u][/b][/p][p]Cooking counter has undergone a minor change, mostly with some improved visuals and polish.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/fc16d0ceb24a7f38f1d815967d506e6856965407.png"][/img][/p][p]The Fryer, Ice Cream Machine, Steamer, and Grill have been slightly adjusted, but are mostly unchanged for now. We may overhaul these games in the future. We would love your feedback regarding these new changes, and what you would like to see improved![/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/1ed495a2d38016e307378a98abee9b8be3428f27.png"][/img][/p][p]Over 10 music tracks have been added to the game. This includes special music for night time, the town square, and for dates. Each festival also has their own unique theme, only available during the main event day.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/52b5c6ced6e7211881991be4475d48448cc6b69d.png"][/img][/p][p]Frame rate options have been added, and can be adjusted in the settings. If you notice stuttering, you may need to try a few options to get the ideal frame rate for your setup. If you notice screen tearing, you should use one of the VSync options. By default, frame rate has been capped at 60 Fps.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/6b0dc9a872490caa32d09a3a76a998db2992619a.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/01c16ca2a6e6d8e4eb53de31ee1c76b1840499b3.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Random NPCs will now interact with various objects around the map, like shops and vending machines. They can also pick up and drop off various items.[/p][/*][*][p]Major and Minor NPCs can now fish, scythe, and water plants in designated spots around the map.[/p][/*][*][p]After chatting with an NPC twice in a day, a final chat bubble dialogue will appear for an NPC. Dialogue depends on friendship level.[/p][/*][*][p]Better item magnet effect and larger pickup range.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/6eca1f36374667cee50b24c0f7957d7910714ac7.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Fixed not being able to use a tool, immediately after picking a plant or picking up an item on the ground.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue of magnifying glass sometimes causing the bow to glitch out.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved magnifying glass responsiveness when multiple objects are close to each other.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue of dialogue sometimes jumping to the next line when not finished writing.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed being able to continuously chat with a “Stranger” level NPC.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed sometimes unable to exit shop with "Menu" command.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/f3866b16356a31965f849c97cbf15e0830b9c9ff.png"][/img][/p][p]Join our Discord to chat with our community, or leave feedback and report bugs. We will be more active on the Discord over the next 2 weeks to chat or help out.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/YpuAH2XTP3" style="button"]Chef RPG Discord[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/0572d3370d14fc7d0d35f302ad6efd68c4e15dac.png"][/img][/p][p]Link to various graphical assets, include new artwork and screenshots :[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://drive.google.com/file/d/1v4sucmWvspWRO889g0SfQiQffzeigP_8/view?usp=drive_link" style="button" buttoncolor="#8f37fb"]Press Kit[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch #19 - Improvements & Fixes
notes.content:
Hi Chefs! Patch #19 is live with a few more improvements and fixes.

[u][b]Improvements[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Added item Stack Splitting. You can split item stacks when inside your main Inventory, Storage, Refrigerator, and Vending Machine.
[*] Improved inventory controls. You can now use Right Click (mouse) or West Button (controllers) to activate certain commands inside Storages and Shops like Transfer All, or Buy / Sell multiple. Previously, this would require Shift + Click (Mouse & Keyboard) or Left Trigger + South Button (Controller). This option is still available, however the key input tooltip has been updated to the simpler version.
[*] More optimal Virtual Cursor (controller only) speeds when doing different activities.
[/list]

[u][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Fixed tooltips sometimes displaying incorrectly when playing on monitors that do not have an aspect ratio of 16:9. This issue seemed to be more common on Macs.
[*] Fixed inconsistent virtual cursor (controller only) speeds when playing on different sized monitors.
[*] Fixed Frier minigame inconsistent movement speed on different computers.
[*] Fixed Grill minigame sometimes unable to pick up ingredients accurately.
[*] Fixed restaurant order tab visual glitch / getting stuck + smoother animations.
[*] Fixed Restaurant service not auto-starting during certain quests.
[*] Fixed floor tiles sometimes not updating visuals correctly.
[*] Fixed floor tiles being able to be placed over Stages & Trapdoor.
[*] Fixed Ingredient deliveries not triggering when sleeping inside Greenhouse or Maintenance room.
[*] Fixed being able to interact with invisible Consumable Panel when inside shops.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch #18 - Some fixes and additional Improvements
notes.content:
Hi Chefs! Patch #18 is live with some fixes and additional improvements for the Version 0.62 update. Thank you for the reports and suggestions!


[u][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Fixed fishing rod sometimes not registering clicks.
[*] Fixed Time & Key inputs UI appearing outside the game screen on certain monitors.
[*] Fixed not being able to sleep inside the Maintenance room & Greenhouse.
[/list]

[u][b]Additional Improvements[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Can now use mouse scroll wheel to cycle through consumable slots.
[*] Smoother camera transition when equipping / unequipping the bow. Previously, the camera jumps too quickly.
[*] Added AM / PM to Clock UI.
[*] Increased collision box of Farming plants (slightly increased range for watering and digging). 
[*] When watering or digging farming plants, the player will now face the direction of the target plant. (Some players mentioned preferring the previous watering method of using the mouse. The change was made to be easier to navigate on controllers, but we can look into a sort of hybrid system where either mouse or keys can be used to water & dig plants).  
[/list]

That’s all for now! We’ve made quite a few changes for the latest Version 0.62 update. Let us know if anything jumps out at you are if you want additional improvements in other features. Some changes can be made quickly, but bigger improvements will be reserved for the next major update.

notes.title: Version 0.62 - Quality of Life features, Improvements, Controls Changes
notes.content:
Hi Chefs! Version 0.62 is now live! This is a general clean-up of the project, and addressing frequently mentioned issues to help us prepare for the next major update. Version 0.62 contains controls changes, numerous quality of life improvements, and many bug fixes. A couple new Machine furniture items have been added as well.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/6eeec38b6801d4f38421d07c3ac4c430c6fc97d3.png[/img]

The biggest change in Version 0.62 involves controls. The consumable slot has been updated to the 10-Slot panel commonly found in other games. The 10-Slot panel gives more options for items to select, and we have found that it is easier to navigate when using a controller. Since this UI is so common, it helps reduce the barriers of entry for new players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/493a3015882fc39d7e31d4dfbbd930ae8ed89583.png[/img]

For Mouse & Keyboard Users, mouse LEFT CLICK can now be used to interact with objects, and automatically equip weapons. You can also Use LEFT CLICK to select slots in the consumables panel.

For Controller users, LEFT / RIGHT shoulder buttons will navigate the consumables panel.
For Playstation Dualsense users : Just a reminder that this controller must be plugged in to work properly.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/358a26730020ad2e1723d96188d03bfdeb940289.png[/img]

Tools have been updated. Scythes, drills, watering cans, spades, and fishing rods no longer need to be equipped before using, so this should help make using tools more streamlined. Bows and Spears will still need to be equipped, since these weapons require aiming.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/7a0a6643deb5e21d1b3e39d56dc71298830d7546.png[/img]

[b][u]Bow Lock-On Feature (Controllers only)[/u][/b]

When aiming a bow, you can now toggle a Lock-On feature, which will make aiming much easier when using a controller.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/a3b020139d50b3350243c9d18e0214bb00c07c9d.png[/img]

Due to the change in the Consumables Slot, some key binds have been updated accordingly. Upon entering the game, your key Rebinds will be reset to the default. If you have custom keybinds, they will need to be remapped again.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/ebbc8e0d26440e09fe25ec4a8d3b19bd246d4733.png[/img]

Reputation has been temporarily disabled as it currently does not have any meaning impact in the game, and does not unlock many features. For the few instances where Reputation score impacts the game, the requirement will now be based on Prestige Instead. We may bring back reputation in the future when new features are added and when it can have a more meaningful impact on the game loop.

The following Reputation requirements will now be based on Prestige :

[list]
[*]	400 Teahouse Reputation required to date Aylin -> Level 6 Prestige. Alternatively, reaching 80% customer Satisfaction in the final dinner service will also provide this unlock.
[*]	Higher Reputation slightly increases the speed at which customers arrived in the restaurant. This is now based on Prestige.
[*]	The Quest Peony’s opening no longer requires a Reputation score. The new requirement is to achieve Level 5 Prestige.
[*]	Unlocking the Rising Star achievement now requires Level 5 Prestige. There will be no impact on previously unlocked achievements.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/132ffef4d4f9b4e9ae62cef1341ec560cd42cf52.png[/img]

Building interiors will now be impacted by day / night cycles. Most buildings will have night lights that will turn on around sunset. For player-owned buildings, a new feature has been added that will allow you to control the lighting style using a new Machine called Light Controller.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/c8b077d5a3a87081aff332e124f71f48e973e830.jpg[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/3088f46eaca1bf2ed0acd8c34bb54d17d14d8fe3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/e4a038fe8bddb0e585a1bdd3aa49f27492bf08e8.png[/img]

[b][u]Light Controller[/u] -----[/b]

This is a new Furniture Item that when placed, can be used to control the lighting in a room. There are 2 lighting modes. You can choose to have the room’s overhead lights to always be on (ignores day night cycle), or turn them off and light your room using decorative lights. More lighting options are available under each mode. By default, before the machine has been placed, the overhead lights will be active (no day / night cycle by default). The blueprint for Light Controllers are automatically unlocked.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/bf65cfa655b8528a12c558bb4bf4e34241c6d130.jpg[/img]

[b][u]Chocolate Maker[/u] -----[/b]

This new machine allows you to convert Cocoa Beans (obtained from farming) into Dark Chocolate. The blueprint for this machine is a rare reward for completing certain activites.

[b][u]Soup Vat[/u] -----[/b]

This new machine allows you to convert Raw Pheasant into Pheasant Stock. The blueprint for this machine is a rare reward for completing certain activites.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/a818988169e1249c7905e659248bbfaffaa3ffff.png[/img]

[list]
[*]	Chefs will wander around and sometimes prep kitchen appliances when the restaurant is closed.
[*]	Waiters will wander around and sometimes clean tables when the restaurant is closed.
[*]	You can now view map quest markers for character quests and misc. quests (previously, this was only available for main story quests).
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/01c16ca2a6e6d8e4eb53de31ee1c76b1840499b3.png[/img]

[list]
[*]	Controller rumble has been added. (Can be turned On/Off in settings).
[*]	Easier to navigate Build Mode when using Controllers.
[*]	Improved interaction system for easier interaction with objects and prevent situations where the interaction icon has been highlighted, but unable to interact with the NPC or object.
[*]	Awards tooltips now display total progress / highest score.
[*]	End of service summary UI has been updated for better readability.

notes.title: Patch #17 & Proposing a Change to our next Update
notes.content:
Hi Chefs! Patch #17 is up with a couple fixes and improvements. We would also like to propose a change to our upcoming Festivals and Relationships Major update.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

ingredients.

[b]Balancing[/b]

-	Slightly increased chance of receiving seeds with the “Seed Collector” skill.
-	Increased chances for rarer minerals and crystals after reaching story Act 2 and 3.


[b]Improvements[/b]

-	Player collider now refreshes after equipping / unequipping tools. Previously, players were unable to pick plants immediately after equipping a tool. Some other collider interactions have been improved as well.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/b1a384f3e7070dda5d3267c117da57280a413df2.png[/img]

[b]Upcoming Content Change Proposal[/b]

Chef RPG’s next planned major update is the Festivals & Relationships update. With our previous Version 0.6 update, we have already diverted from the original roadmap slightly, since we feel it’s important to be flexible and adjust things according to incoming feedback, and the needs of the game. 

For our next update (a much bigger one), we are moving along well with the Festivals content, and have already created a large portion of the art assets. However, after some evaluation, we feel it may not be the best time to commit heavily into Romance (marriage & kids). This is due to the way the game is set up – certain significant areas have not been added to the game yet, and these new locations will make romance far more interesting (etc. travel to exciting date locations,  local delicacies for gifts). Furthermore, certain romanceable characters reside in the City, and will be unable to be romanced if we commit to romance now. 

Due to these reasons, we feel it will be better and more enjoyable for the complete Romance system to be added in our 1.0 launch. It will give us the time to develop the characters more through character quests, add more interesting romance specific locations, and include additional romanceable characters.

In the meantime, certain Festivals will possess romance-related activities (eg. finding a partner) and these can still added to the game in the next update. New character quests will also be introduced to further develop our cast of characters.



[b]Food Over Love[/b]

Instead of committing to Romance, we feel it would be more valuable to work on improving the restaurant gameplay loop at this time. We’ve received a lot of feedback over the past months, and feel like we’ve got a good idea on how to make the restaurant gameplay more exciting and dynamic. There are 3 key things we would like to work on in the upcoming update:

[list]
[*]Improved player interactivity during restaurant service. Be able to dynamically view the service quality and react.

[*]Improved minigames. We haven’t changed minigames too much since launch, but we now have a better idea of how to improve them. We would like to make some bigger changes to minigames, and have the games better resemble “real cooking” while keeping a similar idea as we have now.

[*]Incentives for changing and adapting your restaurant menu. This can be achieved by introducing seasonal ingredients, shopping discounts, and unique groups of customers.
[/list]
Finally, we are still committed to adding a challenging “Chef Mode” to Chef RPG. The exact form this will take will require some testing and experimentation and may differ from our original roadmap.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/d88b6babf3d3aab3832443bc94ca534e1599463d.png[/img]


Let us know your thoughts about this proposed change. Also, feel free to share your thoughts on the restaurant gameplay, and what you would like to see!

notes.title: Chef RPG Version 0.6 Major Update
notes.content:
Hi Chefs!

Chef RPG Version 0.6 is now available! This is our first major content update.
Please note * This is not the Festivals & Relationships update, which will be the next major update.

Update V0.6 Summary

[u][b]New Content[/b][/u]

-	Prestige system
-	Town contribution / upgrades system
-	Crafting System overhaul
-	Chef awards
-	New quests
-	Second level of beach caves

[u][b]Improvements[/b][/u]

-	Pacing and soft-locks
-	Skill changes
-	Minigame improvements
-	Improved SFX
-	Numerous quality of life additions


[u][b]FULL UPDATE DETAILS BELOW[/b][/u]

Warning : Minor spoilers below. Not recommended to read if you have not started the game.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/87b0c9724d6046ca2a06f9ef64bf32ab0240b8aa.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/157e238881d5382f7a1ac6d0de13862a4dd55f2a.png[/img]

We’ve introduced a new progression system into Chef RPG know as Prestige. This is a series of goals to unlock through completing restaurant services. By increasing your Prestige Level, you may be awarded additional Power Cells, Recipes, and Skill Points. An additional of 20 Skill Points can be acquired through the current Prestige System. Prestige will be available after completing the soft opening. In the future, as we continue to develop this system, it will likely replace the Reputation System, as the Reputation Score did not provide clear goals or rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/5565c3af2e76c2d6939fe055e4fcf088b63b5046.jpg[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/724f904079670d1b2f108143ba29ca5a50a769f0.png[/img]

You can now contribute Credits and Resources to the town to earn Contribution Points. Completing bulletin tasks will also provide additional points. Contribution points can be spent on upgrading or unlocking various parts of town. Currently, there are 11 town projects available. No More Shabby Floors, and a new early-game quest must be completed to unlock Town Contributions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/754775ce598631b62bf1909d70bb273db03f3abd.jpg[/img]

The following are some of the available town projects to unlock.

[list]
[*] Birthday Calendar
[*] Barber Shop (New hairstyles available)
[*] New Furniture shop
[*] New Resource Areas
[*] Additional Storage Space
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/78b5bb779b41866542f921d673645ebe0efc18e6.png[/img]

We’ve decided to update the crafting system with some new features. Now, additional characters are able to craft items. Previously, only furniture items could be crafted. Now, rare equipment and tools can also be created via crafting.


[u][b]Blueprints[/b][/u]

Crafting items now require acquiring its corresponding blueprint. Some blueprints will be automatically available, some received after quests, and some blueprints will be acquired though various activities in the game.

[u][b]Ore Refining[/b][/u]

The Furnace has been added to the game. It will allow you to refine Raw Minerals into Metal Plates, which can be used to craft higher level items. The furnace is available after completing a new early-game quest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/3855b389e7a94595465595e93fd99768b5e19ce3.jpg[/img]

[u][b]Additional Resources[/b][/u]

Some new resources have been added to the game for use in crafting.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/90aa5064b41db78a5567f38e0e32125d50c332bf.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/ee539cb75e341f11e115ad008e22f79e14639e47.png[/img]

Completing restaurant services over the course of the game will allow you to unlock various Chef Awards. After meeting the requirements for an Award, you will receive the award by mail the next morning and earn additional Power Cells. More awards will be added in future game updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/fa26cb56ebb2cbba8089b4e4ed888d7f55c92127.jpg[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/5105680a11bbabe15ca475f0c8c034b19ba1a9c9.png[/img]

6 New Early to Mid game side-quests have been added to the game. These quests are primarily intended to improve early game pacing, and also introduce players to certain game mechanics like farming and brewing. New features can be unlocked via these quests, including an empty buildable room that can be used for brewing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/932d676f90c228cafa68d3b90c0c46cb155380e9.jpg[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/0a38a8eb4d8d198c15f7897e2ba5c3f446a2fe23.png[/img]

A second level has been added to the beach caves, that provide mineral deposits for specific resources. You can unlock the different sections of the caves by contributing resource to the town.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/d699692717770df2a6ab4d298a59712c95186a27.jpg[/img]





[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/0e1abe24911dfeb83275c8a9e2d68468c4875e35.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/d99704795a1aa9f7a4f08564a04751994e1f1924.png[/img]

We’ve had many reports of pacing issues, especially around Act 1. Upon further review, the primary cause of this seems to be the gap between Fixing the Fridge, and the Soft Opening Quest, where the player needs to wait several days for the soft opening to fully trigger and complete. We’ve removed several requirements for the Soft Opening, so the quest now triggers much earlier without having to wait several days. 

Previously, the beach caves are unlocked in Act 2, in the middle of Thelio’s Stolen Goods quest. We felt this is a bit late. The beach caves are now unlocked in Act 1, after completing No More Shabby Floors. This will allow you to access the mines, crafting, and Town contributions inside Act 1, before the Grand Opening has begun.

New side quests are now available in Act 1 and early Act 2, which will help increase the number of activities and methods of earning money during the early game.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/824458e75507f44ef60f7c9549341d448673b58b.png[/img]

Previously, starting a major restaurant service quest would prevent you from hosting regular services, until the quest is complete. This has been removed. Furthermore, if you have multiple quests / parties available, you can now cycle between all available services.
Previously, declining certain character quests could prevent you from speaking to that character again until accepting. A new “accept quest” button has been added to prevent this.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/15d3d6c5a4028afab19ea3025c1e8326ef279593.png[/img]

[u][b]Storage Changes[/b][/u]

The storage UI has been updated and provides sorting and “deposit all” features. Hotel and House storage units have now be combined, so they will all share the same space, no matter which building you are standing in. Additional storage upgrades can be made via Town Contributions, to unlock a third safe in town, and up to an additional 48 storage slots. The maximum number of storage slots you can have is now 136.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/fcf070ebf87b25dffc881ad6ba85f690fbf846f9.jpg[/img]

Crafting items and contributing resources to the town can now use resources directly from inside your storage, and the items do not need to be inside your inventory.


[u][b]Collections Tab[/b][/u]

The collections tab has been updated, so you can now view the various ingredients, resources, and blueprints, and awards that you have collected. You can also view information regarding your current Prestige level here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/29b6332fd9e2fb752af92f4193f9ff8437a7503c.jpg[/img]


[u][b]Key Item Tab[/b][/u]

A new tab has been added to the inventory panel that holds quest-related items, so that they do not take up storage space. Existing Quest Items will automatically be transferred over to the Key Item inventory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/6eed3f994b95d34de8f1b99e774ea8ae2f55b9fb.jpg[/img]


[u][b]Note Items[/b][/u]

A new item type has been added : Note Items. These will usually be received via quests and will provide the player with information related to the game. Currently, some brewing notes have been added. Upon reading the note, the corresponding Brewing process will be automatically unlocked inside your brewing recipe book.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/d393ecb7239308eeb8835a629949db8cfa640197.jpg[/img]


[u][b]Various UI Improvements[/b][/u]

We’ve also made various improvements to different UIs to improve clarity and readability.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/0344bc41ffa3bb41cb154e994f15517333acf946.png[/img]

[u][b]Frier Game[/b][/u]

Improved mouse responsiveness and control during. Increased game area for better movement and visibility. Changed the way that dish quality is calculated in this game to better represent the percentage of bubbles hit.

[u][b]Ice Cream Machine[/b][/u]

Improved mouse responsiveness and control, and increased ingredient movement variety. Changed the way that dish quality is calculated in this game to better represent the percentage of ingredients hit.

[u][b]General[/b][/u]

Improved readability and text sizes of tutorials. We will likely update other minigames soon.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/6c35fdf588c2589ecf34a1f1d9f5a2b2ecae43cd.png[/img]

[u][b]Farming[/b][/u]

Skill name has now changed to Seed Collector. Access to farming is no longer unlocked via skill, and is unlocked through an early game quest : In Search of Tomatoes (visit Takashi Farms to start). Seed Collector allows animals and plants to drop seeds.

[u][b]Brewing[/b][/u]

Skill name has been changed to Brewmaster. Access to brewing is no longer unlocked via skill. Brewing is now unlocked after completing the new quest : Brewing a Beer, available in the town when ACT 2 has started.
+5% Dish Quality for recipes that use at least one Alcohol ingredient.

[u][b]Eagle Eyed Shopper[/b][/u]

Added ability for increasing the amount of ingredients sold by vendors.

[u][b]Professional Decorator[/b][/u]

Removed décor value only visible after unlocking this skill. Décor value will now always be visible.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/006e4b80f154901d12cb219961a0e8d0a9feffbb.png[/img]

We have begun working with an audio designer to improve various sound effects in the game. Various new sounds have been added in this update. More changes will follow soon.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/8a5799067b4df54e6427a65313edb66e122a1b9b.png[/img]

[u][b]Power Cells[/b][/u]

We’ve revisited all Power Cells requirements in game, and better adjusted them to meet the rate that they are obtained (factoring in Prestige and Awards). Power Cells requirements for crafting various items, as well as house, storage, and research facility upgrades have been modified.


[u][b]Crafting Materials[/b][/u]

Resource requirements for all crafting products have been readjusted to balance better with the cost and rarity of materials.


[u][b]Player Autocook Dish Quality[/b][/u]

Base dish quality of Auto cooked player dishes has been increased. Scaling with Cooking level has been decreased.


[u][b]Staff Dish Quality[/b][/u]

Base dish quality of dishes made by staff members have been increased. Bonus dish quality from staff Cooking level has been decreased. This means that the dish quality gap between common and legendary chefs have been decreased.


[u][b]Dish Price[/b][/u]

Dish prices have been adjusted slightly. Prices remain tied to cost of ingredients. However, the base price multiplier has been slightly increased, while bonus multipliers from number of ingredients and Rarity have been slightly decreased. This means that basic, common dishes will sell for slightly more than before, while upgraded or rarer dishes sell for slightly less than before.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/a68373e885d704a4b7c8a31d7b5d8480577ebf4d.png[/img]

We sometimes receive reports of the game not working on certain Mac machines, although we have been unable to reproduce the issue on our own Macs. Currently, your computer may give a warning that it will not run 32 Bit games, but the game will still run in most cases. However, please let us know if the game does not run on your Mac - the model and processor type will be useful information to catch any remaining issues with Mac. Thank you.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/1a98efd83406991f8a2e558e277413aa2692a06f.png[/img]

With the new update, the balancing of the game has changed. We would love to hear your feedback, or fix any issues you may have. You can also chat with our growing community in our Discord server here:

https://discord.gg/YpuAH2XTP3

We hope you enjoy your culinary adventures in Chef RPG! More updates coming soon!

notes.title: Controllers & UI Update

Hi Chefs!

Just a few more fixes before we start on the controls update.

[u][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/u]

- Fixed an error where Epic Recipes can be enhanced twice, exceeding the 5 ingredient limit. Attempting to cook these recipes would cause a freeze.

[u][b]Balancing[/b][/u]

- Rebalanced the way that dish sell prices were calculated. Previously, the sell multiplier was solely based on the number of ingredients used, and rarity having no impact on the price. This would result in certain enhanced recipes being able to sell for much more than even legendary recipes. 
The ingredient total multiplier has been reduced, and a rarity multiplier has been added, with the base value increased as well.
In general, common dishes now sell for slightly more, enhanced dishes are reduced, and rarer recipes sell for slightly more as compared to enhanced dishes.

[u][b]Improvements[/b][/u]

- Dish quality requirement to unlock Autocook for minigames reduced from 95 to 70. Some players were having issues with these games due to accessibility, or controller limitations. We will look into finding a better solution for autocook down the road.

- Added a few more button key indicators for the Restaurant Management menu - the shift between Left Mouse Click and Right Mouse Click between different UIs is confusing to players. We will fully fix this with the controls update.

- I, O, and P are now alternate buttons for 1,2 and 3. This is a temporary fix for players with certain unique keyboards. This will not be needed after the controls update.

[u][b]Moving Forward[/b][/u]

We will keep an eye on any bugs that pop up for a few more days, and begin overhauling the controls. Once we start, we be unable to patch the game until it is complete, since the inner workings of the game will be modified. We will also take this opportunity to overhaul a lot of the UI as well, since many players have expressed confusion towards the controls, especially when entering the game for the first time.  We will add key-input prompts for most activities during this overhaul. Some of the UI is also quite old and and requires an upgrade.

We will also look into adding ultrawide support and windowed mode, since these items are tied to UI. More info on this soon.

That's it for now!

[b]Improvements[/b]

-	Better plant colliders – easier to interact with Hand Pick plants


[b]Skill System Update[/b]

Based on player feedback, we’ve decided to make some changes to the Skills System, and the way that players level up. Previously, any activity would give the player general experience, and skill points earned can be used to increase any Stat. 

We’ve decided to remove general player EXP and split EXP gain between each separate Ability (Endurance, Gathering, Cooking, Social). This way, performing cooking actions will automatically increase your Cooking Stat. Social activities will only increase Social Stat. Harvesting, Fishing, Hunting, and Mining will increase the Gathering Stat. Most physical activities will slightly increase your Endurance Stat. Your player’s level is recalculated based on the 4 Stats combined (minus 10 due to the starting Stats). 

Skill Points will increase as normal, 1 per level up. We have raised the Stat cap to 15, and the total Player Level cap to 50. This way, there are 10 extra Skill Points to earn towards your build.

*Note due to the recalculation, your Player level on entering the game will be slightly lower than before, with slightly lower total Skill Points. Stats will remain the same, with a new level cap of 15.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/a41262367d7df1d1cd88b7f3c6ad1d5c8f8f52ff.jpg[/img]
Updated skill panel

Skill Reset

Originally, we planned to add an NPC that does this, however, we do not want to lock players out of trying new builds until this NPC is included in the game. This button will become available at player level 30, and can be used once every 5 days. This will not affect your Stats.

We’ve also received feedback on requiring more storage space for items. We can definitely look into this, and find a suitable solution to implement additional storage soon!

-	Eliminated doubles of the same character displayed in map.
-	Fixed issue where you cannot pick up and place furniture when opening Build Mode.
-	Fixed some text errors.

Another issue that seems to occur is that in the case of certain crashes (sometimes from external sources like power outage), the save file can become corrupt. This usually happens if the game suddenly closes in the middle of saving. Previously, a corrupt save file could disrupt the main load screen. The game can now read if a file is corrupt, so you can now load a backup save properly. We will continue looking for ways that the game could cause an internal crash, and try to fix these soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/37aa8bd2d81a4d981ff74f9f0578b200e7476354.jpg[/img]
Fix for load game issue.


Another issue players have encountered is sometimes waiters or chefs get stuck. This one is a bit harder to reproduce, but we should have a fix for this soon.

Appreciate the reports. More updates coming!

notes.title: Patch #2 - Fixes, Improvements, & A Quality of Life Update
notes.content:
Hey Chefs, here is a bigger patch with several fixes, improvements, and we managed to squeeze in one quality of life update!

[b]Improvements[/b]

-	Much easier to interact with Major NPCs now, without other NPCs getting in the way. 
-	Increased hitboxes of Boars & Elks
-	Arrows are now much more accurate and hit their target more frequently
-	Overhauled player’s collider so now less likely to get stuck.
-	Change “SP” in Skill Tooltip to Skill Points for more clarity.

[b]Bug fixes [/b]

-	Added a fix to prevent several possible black screens. This likely happens when certain inputs are made when changing scenes. We will keep an eye out for any other occurrences.
-	Fixed an issue where non-consumable items (like clothing) can be placed inside the consumables slot.
-	Chat prompt will return after speaking to an NPC and closing the chat window
-	Disabled certain inputs that could potentially cause freezes
-	Fixed quest name not displaying in “load from previous quest button.”
-	More typo corrections

[b]First Quality of Life Addition![/b]

Main story Quests will now show on the world map. This will make it more straightforward to find the Quest Target without needing to jump into the menu every time.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/f8099ec703828a40a626a635a8e712e446c92252.jpg[/img]


We will have more daily updates - for the next few days!

notes.title: Chef RPG Minor Patch #1
notes.content:
Hi Chefs,

Thank you for playing Chef RPG!

Although this was a very exciting day, this launch could have gone smoother. We were made of numerous issues present in the game, and we understand this can be disappointing when diving into the game for the first time. The good news is that most of these issues can be fixed fairly quickly. This patch fixes most of the text / spelling errors present in the game. We will take a deeper run through and try to catch any remaining text errors.

Some players also experienced forced movement in 1 direction. This is likely caused by having a controller plugged in, or a having a virtual controller. We have a made a small tweak to joystick sensitivity, and hope this could fix this issue. For now, we will not fully remove joystick controls since some players have already started playing with Steamdeck.

As for the rest of the bugs, once we are aware of the specific bug and can recreate it, it should be very quick to fix. We are doing a run through to find the more serious bugs posted today, and hopefully they can be resolved by end of day.

Some players also posted good quality of life suggestions like better map & quest tracking and improved UI. Once bugs are resolved, we can implement these features in just a few days.

Either way, we apologize for these issues and they should hopefully be resolved very quickly!

notes.title: Chef RPG New Trailer and Early Access September 12th
notes.content:
Hi all! Thank you for following Chef RPG over the past two years and we are excited to announce that Chef RPG will release in early access for PC and Mac on September 12! A new Official Trailer has been unveiled, which you can view here. It gives a sneak peak into the current state of the game, and some of the new content you can expect to see.

[previewyoutube=bKySdMKzgZ8;full][/previewyoutube]

We would love to hear your feedback during this early access period to shape the path towards the 1.0 release. Chef RPG introduces unique RPG mechanics and your suggestions will help us create a fun and addicting RPG experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/872b0b8ce47815c1663cfce629a0442e3834e87c.jpg[/img]

Although we will continue to develop this game, Chef RPG already contains tons of activities for you to enjoy, and a fascinating world for you to explore. 

[h3]Features in the Game[/h3]
[list]
[*] 3 Story Acts that contains more than 20 story + character quests.
[*] 2 Restaurants to customize and manage.
[*] Over 240 Recipes to collect.
[*] A dense open world to explore and every building can be entered.
[*] Dynamic weather system that affects appearance of ingredients and animals.
[*] Dozens of natural ingredients to forage in the game world.
[*] Over a dozen creatures to hunt, and secret bosses to discover.
[*] You can also fish, farm, and brew ingredients.
[*] Mine crystals and ores to craft unique machines and artisan furniture.
[*] 40 unique skills to unlock and customize your build.
[*] 36 research skills can be discovered in research facilities to refine your cooking specialty.
[*] Over 20 major characters to befriend and romance.
[*] Over 30 minor characters to meet in your journey.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/fc097acf34edc28ba99d6adeebf61ce4c25677e4.jpg[/img]

[h3]Features we plan on developing during the Early Access[/h3]
[list]
[*] Controller & Steam deck support (might be possible for initial launch - more details soon).
[*] Further developing romance system.
[*] Festivals
[*] Fishing Expansion with new area to explore
[*] More items to collect and furniture to decorate with.
[*] More character quests & misc quests.
[*] Suggestions from feedback.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514609/0810749d56c6781dbe5fde68da32e09066fcf919.jpg[/img]

[h3]Planned features for Chef RPG 1.0[/h3]
[list]
[*] Completed story and new quests.
[*] New city to explore.
[*] More restaurants to unlock and manage.
[*] New challenging end-game content.
[*] Localization for multiple languages.
[/list]

That’s it for now! We are very excited for Chef RPG’s first release and we really hope you will enjoy the game when it launches. More updates coming soon!
